tbesh_html:
1) to sing, sing praise, make music
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to make music, sing
1a2) to play a musical instrument
Aramaic equivalent: ze.mar (זְמָר "music" H2170)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps identical with H2168 (זָמַר) through the idea of striking with the fingers); properly, to touch the strings or parts of a musical instrument, i.e.
strongs_1890.kjv_def: give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.
